subproperty: paired bootstrap, Phase12@300 vs RS-SFT hits
method_note: Paired by construction: each of the 10,000 replicates draws ONE set of resampled positions per target and applies it to BOTH models' 32-sample arrays for that target (both have exactly 32 samples/target), so within-replicate noise common to both models (e.g. a target where resampling happens to drop its only hit for one model) cancels in the diff rather than inflating the CI.
